scripts.prepare-column-jobs.py:
import json,hashlib,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('build/column-probes-cloud'); b.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
remote='/home/mgsloan/column-probes-20260914'
for d in ['jobs','inputs','grammars','queries']: (b/d).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
old=Path('build/kernel-probes-cloud')
jobs=json.loads((old/'jobs.json').read_text()); walks=json.loads((old/'walk-jobs.json').read_text())
for j in jobs: shutil.copy2(old/'jobs'/(j['name']+'.json'),b/'jobs')
extra=json.loads(Path('build/supertype-cache-bench/inputs.json').read_text())
for i in extra:
 if i['grammar'] not in ['csharp','sml']:continue
 g=i['grammar']; src=Path(i['source']); lib=Path(i['library'])
 shutil.copy2(src,b/'inputs'/src.name); shutil.copy2(lib,b/'grammars'/lib.name)
 q=subprocess.check_output(['build/super-names',str(lib),i['symbol']],text=True)
 (b/'queries'/(g+'.scm')).write_text(q)
 j=dict(name=i['name']+'-supertypes',kind='supertype',grammar_name=g,grammar=dict(library=remote+'/grammars/'+lib.name,symbol=i['symbol'],library_sha256=i['library_sha256']),sources=[dict(path=remote+'/inputs/'+src.name,sha256=i['source_sha256'])],query=dict(name=g+'-supertypes',path=remote+'/queries/'+g+'.scm',sha256=hashlib.sha256(q.encode()).hexdigest()),size_class='tiny' if 'tiny' in i['name'] else 'medium')
 jobs.append(j); (b/'jobs'/(j['name']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(j,indent=2))
 w={k:v for k,v in j.items() if k not in ['kind','query']};w['name']=i['name'];walks.append(w)
 local=json.loads(json.dumps(j).replace(remote,str(b.resolve())))
 (b/'jobs'/(j['name']+'-local.json')).write_text(json.dumps(local,indent=2))
widths=dict(bash=(9,5),c=(9,6),cpp=(10,6),css=(8,2),go=(8,6),html=(6,2),json=(5,2),python=(9,6),tsx=(9,6),typescript=(9,6),yaml=(9,2))
selected={}
for j in jobs+walks:
 vs=['exact','control','super']
 if j['grammar_name'] in widths:
  s,f=widths[j['grammar_name']];vs+=['field'+str(f)]
  if s!=8:vs+=['symbol'+str(s)]
  if f==6 and s in [9,10]:vs+=['both']
 selected[j['name']]=vs
for name,data in [('jobs',jobs),('walk-jobs',walks),('job-variants',selected)]: (b/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2))

tar -xzf /home/mgsloan/column-probes-cloud.tar.gz -C /home/mgsloan
cd /home/mgsloan/column-probes-20260914
python3 benchmark-kernel-probes.py . --kind query --variants exact,control,field2,field5,field6,symbol5,symbol6,symbol9,symbol10,both,super --job-variants job-variants.json --points 1,0 --rounds 3 --repeat 5 --tag column-queries

touch column-complete
